data.title: BMNR Stock Falls Despite Bitmine Retiring Over 16M Shares In 3 Weeks – Tom Lee Highlights Ethereum’s Edge Over Nasdaq 100
data.description: Shares of Bitmine Immersion Technologies (BMNR) slipped Monday morning after the company said it repurchased 4.5 million shares last week, lifting total buybacks to 16.1 million shares over the past three weeks.Executive Chairman Tom Lee said the move was driven by a favorable setup following Ether…
